Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly altered Giuseppe Cesari’s death year from the verified 1640 to 1604, yielding a false lifespan of ~36 years. This misreading/transcription error contradicted earlier sourced data and led to an erroneous comparison (compounded by a slight miscalculation of Poulantzas’s age as ~44 instead of 43), risking the wrong conclusion about who lived longer.
